collection.title: Lexus NX Series 2021 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Lexus NX Series 2021 Onwards model which requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 16" for the passengers side. This model uses the Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. There is also the option to upgrade to the newer Retrofit blade. We also have the rear blade for this NX Series, simply click the Rear Blades tab below.
